properties.text: THE SIMPLE PENDULUM -- a physics plate drawn by one Figure node.  Spin the wheel over the two knobs: LENGTH stretches the rod and moves the period bar at the foot of the plate; RELEASE ANGLE swings the bob and adds only the thin red tail on the end of that bar.  That red tail is the whole lesson -- at 10 degrees the period is 0.2 % longer than the textbook 2*pi*sqrt(L/g), and you have to reach 45 degrees before it is 4 %.  Nothing on the plate is a picture: every coordinate in the Figure's program is an expression over the two knob values, and the period is computed in the program's own assignment lines.

properties.program:
# THE SIMPLE PENDULUM
#
# Two knobs: the LENGTH of the rod and the ANGLE it is released
# from.  The period listens to one of them and very nearly ignores
# the other, which is the whole lesson of the plate: wind the angle
# and watch the red sliver on the period bar refuse to grow.

view -76, -95, 76, 22
align "centre", "middle"
color "#202020"

g  = 9.80665
th = radians(theta)

# The rod is drawn 32 units to the metre, so a pendulum twice as
# long really is twice as long on the plate.
Ld = 32 * L
xb =  Ld * sin(th)
yb = -Ld * cos(th)
rb = clamp(0.085 * Ld, 1.8, 5)

# --- the support, hatched the way a plate hatches a wall ----------
width 1.4
line -26, 0, 26, 0
width 0.7
line -24, 0, -30, 6
line -16, 0, -22, 6
line  -8, 0, -14, 6
line   0, 0,  -6, 6
line   8, 0,   2, 6
line  16, 0,  10, 6
line  24, 0,  18, 6

# --- the plumb line, and the arc the bob actually travels ---------
color "#909090"
width 0.5
dash "dot"
line 0, 0, 0, -Ld - 6
arc 0, 0, Ld, -90 - theta, -90 + theta
dash "solid"

# --- the far extreme, drawn hollow: a swing has two ends ----------
line 0, 0, -xb, yb
circle -xb, yb, rb

# --- the angle at the pivot ---------------------------------------
# The mark sits on the bisector, but never closer to the vertical
# than 12 degrees and never further out than the bob -- a small
# angle on a short rod would otherwise print the label on the rod.
ra = min(clamp(0.45 * Ld, 5, 20), 0.75 * Ld)
ha = max(th / 2, radians(12))
rl = min(ra + 6, 0.62 * Ld)
color "#202020"
width 0.6
arc 0, 0, ra, -90, -90 + theta
font 5
text rl * sin(ha), -rl * cos(ha), "θ₀"

# --- the rod and the bob ------------------------------------------
width 1.6
line 0, 0, xb, yb
fill "#3a4a6b"
circle xb, yb, rb
nofill

# the pivot last, so it sits on top of both rods
fill "#606060"
circle 0, 0, 1.8
nofill

# ==================================================================
#  THE PERIOD
#  T0 is the small-angle answer, T adds the first two terms of the
#  correction the release angle brings with it.
# ==================================================================
T0 = 2 * pi * sqrt(L / g)
T  = T0 * (1 + th * th / 16 + 11 * th * th * th * th / 3072)

# Drawn as a LENGTH on a seconds scale, so sqrt(L) is something you
# watch grow.  The bar is clamped to the scale, so a hand-widened
# knob cannot draw off the plate; the printed number stays exact.
sc = 36
bx = -62
by = -76
Tc = min(T, 3.5)

color "#202020"
width 0.6
line bx, by, bx + 3.5 * sc, by
line bx,            by, bx,            by - 3
line bx + 0.5 * sc, by, bx + 0.5 * sc, by - 2
line bx + 1.0 * sc, by, bx + 1.0 * sc, by - 3
line bx + 1.5 * sc, by, bx + 1.5 * sc, by - 2
line bx + 2.0 * sc, by, bx + 2.0 * sc, by - 3
line bx + 2.5 * sc, by, bx + 2.5 * sc, by - 2
line bx + 3.0 * sc, by, bx + 3.0 * sc, by - 3
line bx + 3.5 * sc, by, bx + 3.5 * sc, by - 2

font 4
align "centre", "top"
text bx,            by - 4.5, "0"
text bx + 1.0 * sc, by - 4.5, "1"
text bx + 2.0 * sc, by - 4.5, "2"
text bx + 3.0 * sc, by - 4.5, "3 s"

# blue is the small-angle period; the red tail on the end is
# everything the release angle added to it
width 0.4
fill "#3a4a6b"
rect bx, by + 1.5, T0 * sc, 4
fill "#b03a2e"
rect bx + T0 * sc, by + 1.5, (Tc - T0) * sc, 4
nofill

color "#202020"
font 4.6
align "right", "bottom"
text 74, by + 7, "T = %.3f s", T

# --- the numbers, in the corners the pendulum can never reach -----
font 5
align "right", "top"
text 74, 20, "The simple pendulum"

font 4
align "left", "top"
text -74, 20,   "L = %.2f m    θ₀ = %.0f°", L, theta
text -74, 15.2, "T₀ = 2π√(L/g) = %.3f s", T0
color "#b03a2e"
text -74, 10.4, "the angle adds %.2f %%", 100 * (T / T0 - 1)
color "#202020"
text -74, 5.6,  "the mass adds nothing"
